senses.gloss: f. (צָפָה; cmp. Syr. צפיותא, P. Sm. 3429) clearness, the liquid parts of honey cells.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 48b:16">Sot. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>דבש הבא מן הצ׳</he> the honey which comes from the inner portions of the cells (= <he>נופת צופים</he>), v. <cite ref="N00396"><he>נוֹפֶת</he></cite>; Y. ib. IX, 24ᵇ bot. <he>דבש הבא בצִפְיָיה</he> honey which comes in a state of clearness.
